items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: he had relatives there, my aunt, his sister, Aunt Maureen.

ctx.x: From Indianapolis, where we were actually, my home. We were born there. Because he had moved to Columbus and he was staying with his...he had relatives there, my aunt, his sister, Aunt Maureen. And we went to Columbus and ended up staying there ten years, almost to the day, that I came back. I was 19 when I come back to Indianapolis to live. In the meantime, my older brother June died in that period that we were in Columbus. And Wes and I moved back to Indianapolis ten years later.

And Wes was the first, naturally, to get off into the music. Well, I shouldn't say that. June was, but he passed earlier. He was two years older than I. Because he was two years older than I and Wes was two years younger than I, there was actually four years between Wes's age and his, roughly that is.
